note: Al-Wird al-Sharīf known as Ḥizb al-Ghāyāt — the litany of ultimate ends, for declaring the oneness of Allah, who fulfils all needs. Attributed to Mawlānā Jalāl ad-Dīn Muḥammad al-Balkhī ar-Rūmī (604–672 AH / 1207–1273 CE).

verses.en: In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Most Merciful.

verses.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ وَالصَّلٰوةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلٰى رَسُولِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى اٰلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ اَجْمَعِينَ
verses.tr: Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn · Wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʿalā Rasūlinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn
verses.en: Praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Blessings and peace be upon our Messenger Muhammad, and upon his family and his companions, all of them.

verses.ar: لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ ۞ اَللّٰهُمَّ يَآ اِلٰهِى ۞ اَنَا الْعَبْدُ وَاَنْتَ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Lā ilāha illā-Llāh, Muḥammadun Rasūlu-Llāh · Allāhumma yā Ilāhī · Anā l-ʿabdu wa-Anta-Llāh
verses.en: There is no god but Allah; Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, O my God. I am the servant, and You are Allah.
I am the one who affirms Your oneness, and You are the One.
I am the lowly little servant, and You are the One worshipped.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا مُمْكِنُ الْوُجُودِ وَاَنْتَ وَاجِبُ الْوُجُودِ
verses.tr: Wa-anā mumkinu l-wujūdi wa-Anta wājibu l-wujūd
verses.en: I am contingent in being, and You are necessary in being.
I am the created, and You are the Creator.
I am the one brought into being, and You are the One who brings into being.
I am the newly originated, and You are the Originator, the Beginningless.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْهَالِكُ وَاَنْتَ الْبَاقِى بِلَا زَوَالٍ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-hāliku wa-Anta l-Bāqī bi-lā zawāl
verses.en: I am the one who perishes, and You are the Abiding, without ceasing.
I am the one who passes away, and You are the Everlasting, the Abiding.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْمَيِّتُ وَاَنْتَ الْمُمِيتُ الْحَىُّ الَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-mayyitu wa-Anta l-Mumītu l-Ḥayyu lladhī lā yamūt
verses.en: I am the one who dies, and You are the Giver of death, the Living who does not die.
I am the powerless, and You are the Able, the Omnipotent.
I am the poor, and You are the Rich, the Enricher.
I am the lowly, and You are the Majestic, the Mighty.
I am the ailing, and You are the Healer.
I am the needy, and You are the Self-Sufficient, the One.
I am the paltry, and You are the Magnificent, the One.
I am the small, and You are the Great, the Exalted.
I am the overcome, and You are the Prevailing.
I am the one who seeks help, and You are the Helper.
I am the one astray, and You are the Guide, sure in guidance.
I am the wrongdoer, and You are the Equitable, the Just.
I am the loser, and You are the Deliverer.
I am the deficient, and You are the Complete.
I am the lowest, and You are the Raiser, the Giver of honour.
I am want itself, and You are the Glorified.
I am the ignorant, and You are the Knowing.
I am the disobedient, and You are the Ever-Forgiving.
I am the hasty, and You are the Patient.
I am the sinner, and You are the Forgiving.
I am the bondsman, and You are the Owner.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الدَّاعِى وَاَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ بِلَآ اِيجَابٍ
verses.tr: Wa-anā d-dāʿī wa-Anta l-Mujību bi-lā ījāb
verses.en: I am the one who calls, and You are the One who answers, bound by no obligation.
I am the asker, and You are the Giver, the Bestower of favour.
I am the repentant, and You are the Ever-Relenting.
I am the miserly, and You are the Generous.
I am the one who gives thanks, and You are the Most Appreciative.
I am the one who praises, and You are the Praiseworthy.
I am the one who extols, and You are the Extolled.
I am the one who remembers, and You are the Remembered.
I am the seeker, and You are the Sought.
I am the loving one, and You are the Beloved.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْعَاشِقُ الصُّورِىُّ وَاَنْتَ الْمَعْشُوقُ الْحَقِيقِىُّ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-ʿāshiqu ṣ-ṣūriyyu wa-Anta l-maʿshūqu l-ḥaqīqī
verses.en: I am the lover of outward forms, and You are the truly Beloved.

verses.ar: وَاَنَا الْقَاصِدُ وَاَنْتَ الْمَقْصُودُ لِاَنَّهُ لَا مَقْصُودَ سِوَاكَ
verses.tr: Wa-anā l-qāṣidu wa-Anta l-maqṣūdu li-annahu lā maqṣūda siwāk
verses.en: I am the one who aims, and You are the aim — for there is no goal but You.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا قَدْرَ لِى اِلَّا قَدْرُكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma lā qadra lī illā qadruk
verses.en: O Allah, I have no worth but the worth You give,
and no guidance but Your guidance,
and no bounty but Your bounty,

verses.ar: وَلَا تَوْفِيقَ لِى اِلَّا تَوْفِيقُكَ وَلَا نِعَمَ لِى اِلَّا نَعْمَآؤُكَ
verses.tr: Wa-lā tawfīqa lī illā tawfīquk, wa-lā niʿama lī illā naʿmāʾuk
verses.en: and no success but that You grant it, and no blessings but Your blessings,
and no power but Your power,
and no strength but Your strength,

verses.ar: وَلَا فَيْضَ لِى اِلَّا فَيْضُكَ وَكُلٌّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
verses.tr: Wa-lā fayḍa lī illā fayḍuk, wa-kullun min ʿindik
verses.en: and no outpouring but Your outpouring — all of it is from You.
I place my trust in You and hold fast to You.

verses.ar: وَاَنْتَ اللّٰهُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِى لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
verses.tr: Wa-Anta-Llāhu ṣ-Ṣamadu lladhī lam yalid wa-lam yūlad wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad
verses.en: And You are Allah, the Self-Sufficient upon whom all depend, who neither begets nor is begotten, and to whom none is comparable.

verses.ar: اِلٰهِى مَقْصُودِى رِضَاكَ وَلِقَاؤُكَ يَسِّرْهُمَا لِى
verses.tr: Ilāhī maqṣūdī riḍāka wa-liqāʾuka yassirhumā lī
verses.en: My God, what I seek is Your good pleasure and to meet You — make them easy for me.

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِنِى سُؤْلِى اَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِى قَلْبِى وَلَا تَحْتَاجُ اِلٰى مَقَالِى
verses.tr: Allāhumma aʿṭinī suʾlī, Anta taʿlamu mā fī qalbī wa-lā taḥtāju ilā maqālī
verses.en: O Allah, grant me my request. You know what is in my heart and have no need of my speech.
O Succour of all who cry for succour, come to our aid.
Answer our supplication and our pleading,
by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

verses.ar: وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ اَجْمَعِينَ
verses.tr: Wa-ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn
verses.en: And may Allah bless our master Muhammad, his family and his companions, all of them.

verses.ar: تَمَّ بِحَمْدِ اللّٰهِ ۞ وَمِنَ اللّٰهِ التَّوْفِيقُ ۞ اَلْفَاتِحَةُ
verses.en: Completed with the praise of Allah. Success is from Allah alone. — al-Fātiḥah.
